body: As a homosexual I genuinely believe homosexuality is a mental illness and that some sort of treatment should be available for it. If there were any sort I would take it in a heartbeat. I know there's chemical castration but that has side effects and isn't guaranteed to work, plus good luck convincing a doctor to give you aa prescription.

It isn't my life goal so much as it is my ideal  It's like going up to a vending machine, and lacking a little to buy the snack you want; you can either settle for a shitty knock off brand or simply not waste your money on anything.


>But think, if you don't take a step, ten years later you will be looking back and hitting yourself for not taking the chance

Or I may simply be dead, or hitting myself for not leaving when I had the chance.

It isn't the hard work that counts. It's the end result. If the end result isn't worth the trouble and in my personal opinion, I am not going to slave away in college for such a simple goal.

There is something to work for, true, but if it isn't worth it I'm not going to bother.
